_about: Challenge lines for the enemies standing in the test room (data/world/room_fights.json). Loud, goofy, short. Each ends in a Fight? choice; the yes conversation plays and then the fight starts.

challenge_grunt.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt.text: HALT! Signals Patrol! Do you have a permit for standing there?

challenge_grunt.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt.text: ...Neither do I! Fight me to settle it!

challenge_grunt_no.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt_no.text: Fine! But I'm writing you a ticket for that!

challenge_drone.speaker: enemy_drone
challenge_drone.text: BZZZT! Intruder detected! Also a flock! We are a flock!

challenge_squad.speaker: enemy_squad
challenge_squad.text: ATTENTION! This is a FULL Signals Squad! All four of us! Count us!

challenge_squad_no.speaker: enemy_squad
challenge_squad_no.text: Smart. We were only three-and-a-half sure.

challenge_tough.speaker: enemy_tough
challenge_tough.text: I am the QUOTA ENFORCER. Nobody leaves my quota!

challenge_tough_no.speaker: enemy_tough
challenge_tough_no.text: Hmph. The quota will wait. It's very patient.
